findings.message: Insecure path boundary check (CWE-22): 'os.path.commonprefix' compares paths character-by-character rather than by directory segments, allowing sibling-prefix Path Traversal bypasses (e.g. '/app/static' matching '/app/static_disallowed'). Validate containment using a path-segment-aware canonical path check instead of character-prefix matching.
